Rashi on Nedarim 50b:10:1.hebrew: לא אזמני' לבר קפרא - לפי שהיה איש בדחן, ומתיירא רבי שמא יעשה שום דבר שישחוק:
Rashi on Nedarim 50b:10:1.english: He did not invite Bar Kappara - Because he was a jester, and [Rabbi] was afraid lest he do something that would cause laughter.

Rashi on Nedarim 50b:10:2.hebrew: אמר - בר קפרא לרבי: אם לעוברי רצונו משפיע לו טובה כ"כ, לעושי רצונו כו' — שהיה מגנהו על שלא זימנו:
Rashi on Nedarim 50b:10:2.english: He said - Bar Kappara [said] to Rabbi: "If to those who transgress His will He bestows so much good, [then] to those who perform His will, etc." — for he was reproaching him for not having invited him.

Rashi on Nedarim 50b:10:3.hebrew: לעושי רצונו - משפיע לו בעוה"ז טובה כ"כ, שהתחיל לספר בשבחו בשביל שזימנו:
Rashi on Nedarim 50b:10:3.english: To those who perform His will - [God] bestows upon him in this world so much goodness, for [bar Kappara] began to speak in his praise because he invited him.

Rashi on Nedarim 50b:1:1.hebrew: ומן אשתו של טורנוסרופוס - אדון אחד ששמו רופוס, והיה מפטפט בדברי תורה כנגד ר"ע, והיה ר"ע מנצחו בכל פעם, והיה אותו אדון מתבייש, ובא וסיפר לאשתו. אמרה לו: אני אפתהו ואכשילהו, לפי שהיתה יפת תואר ביותר. באתה אצלו וגילתה שוקה כנגדו, ורק ר"ע ושחק ובכה. אמרה לו: מדוע עשית כן? אמר לה: השנים אומר לך: מה שרקקתי — בשביל שמטיפה סרוחה באת; ובכיתי — בשביל שיופיך עתיד לבלות בארץ. ומה ששחק לא רצה לומר לה; אעפ"כ הפצירה בו, עד שאמר לה שעתידה להתגייר ותנשא לו. אמרה לו: וכי יש תשובה? אמר לה: הן. ונתגיירה לאחר שמת בעלה, ונשאת לו, והביאה לו ממון גדול:
Rashi on Nedarim 50b:1:1.english: And from the wife of Turnus Rufus - [There was] a certain nobleman whose name was Rufus, and he used to prattle in words of Torah against Rabbi Akiva, and Rabbi Akiva would defeat him every time, and that nobleman would be humiliated, and he came and told his wife. She said to him: "I will seduce him and cause him to stumble," because she was exceedingly beautiful. She came to him and uncovered her leg before him, and Rabbi Akiva spat, and laughed, and wept. She said to him: "Why did you do so?" He said to her: "Two [of them] I will tell you: why I spat — because you came from a putrid drop; and I wept — because your beauty is destined to decay in the earth." And as for why he laughed, he did not want to tell her; nevertheless, she pressed him until he told her that she was destined to convert and be married to him. She said to him: "Is there repentance?" He said to her: "Yes." And she converted after her husband died, and she married him, and brought him great wealth.

Rashi on Nedarim 50b:1:2.hebrew: מן קטיעא בר שלום - מפורש במסכת ע"ז בפ"ק (דף י:):
Rashi on Nedarim 50b:1:2.english: From Ketia bar Shalom - [This] is explained in Tractate Avodah Zarah in the first chapter (10b).

Rashi on Nedarim 50b:2:2.english: [It] entered a hole - The monkey entered a hole in the ground.

Rashi on Nedarim 50b:5:1.hebrew: הכי דנן - כמו שדנתני אתה, בתמיה:
Rashi on Nedarim 50b:5:1.english: Would he have judged me thus - Like you have judged me, [said] in astonishment.

Rashi on Nedarim 50b:5:2.english: Did you know him - [Were you] acquainted with him?

Rashi on Nedarim 50b:5:3.english: And his belly is large - He has a large belly.

Rashi on Nedarim 50b:6:1.hebrew: טורמיטא עבדה דעביד ליה - לההיא ביצה טורמיטא, שווי אלפא זוזי:
Rashi on Nedarim 50b:6:1.english: Turemita; a slave who prepares it - [who prepares] that turemita egg, [he] is worth a thousand zuz.

Rashi on Nedarim 50b:6:2.english: Until it shrinks - That it diminishes so that one can swallow it whole.

Rashi on Nedarim 50b:6:3.hebrew: ואי אית ביה כיבא - במעיו, סריך עליה — על ההיא ביצה — וניכר בה:
Rashi on Nedarim 50b:6:3.english: And if there is a lesion in him - in his intestines, [it] adheres to it — to that egg — and is discernible on it.

Rashi on Nedarim 50b:6:4.hebrew: וכדנפקא ממעיו - שלימה, ידע אסיא כו':
Rashi on Nedarim 50b:6:4.english: And when it emerges from his bowels - whole, the doctor knows, etc.

Rashi on Nedarim 50b:7:1.hebrew: הוה בדיק נפשיה בקולחא - היינו דומיא דביצה טורמיטא, והיה מפשפש כל מעיו אם יש בהן כאב, והיה מתחלש ומתעלף כל כך, עד שאשתו בוכה עליו ותולשת שערה מחמת דאגה:
Rashi on Nedarim 50b:7:1.english: He would examine himself with a stalk - This is similar to a turemita egg, and he would probe all his intestines [to see] if there was pain in them, and he would become so weak and faint that his wife would weep over him and tear out her hair out of worry.

Rashi on Nedarim 50b:8:1.english: He was working - [This refers to] the worker who gathers keloppasin for him.

Rashi on Nedarim 50b:8:2.hebrew: לא יאכל בבנות שבע - שלא הרשתו התורה לאכול אלא מאותו המין שהוא מלקט, דכתיב כי תבא בכרם רעך ואכלת ענבים וגו' (דברים כג):
Rashi on Nedarim 50b:8:2.english: He may not partake of benot sheva - For the Torah permitted him to eat only from that [same] species which he is picking, as it is written: "When you enter your neighbor's vineyard, you may eat grapes, etc." (Deuteronomy 23[:25]).

Rashi on Nedarim 50b:9:1.english: To teach him a thousand varieties of lafdei - That he should teach him to make a thousand varieties of food.

Rashi on Nedarim 50b:9:2.english: He summoned him for judgment - For the two hundred varieties that he did not teach him.

Rashi on Nedarim 50b:9:3.hebrew: אבותינו אמרו נשינו טובה - דכתיב "נשיתי טובה" (איכה ג׳:י״ז), שראוה כבר, אלא שעכשיו שכחוה. אבל אנו לא ראינו טובה מעולם, שאין אנו יודעים כמה מיני טעם יש בפירות. כלומר, דבר מופלא הוא שכל כך לימדו:
Rashi on Nedarim 50b:9:3.english: Our forefathers said: We have forgotten prosperity - As it is written, "I have forgotten prosperity" (Lamentations 3:17), [meaning] that they had already seen it, except that now they have forgotten it; but we have never seen prosperity, as we do not know how many kinds of flavor there are in fruits. That is to say, it is a wondrous thing that he taught him so much.

Tosafot on Nedarim 50b:1:1.hebrew: אשתו של טורנוסרופוס - שהיה ר"ע מקפח טורנוסרופוס לפני קיסר בקראי. פעם אחת הלך לביתו זועף. אמרה לו אשתו: "מפני מה פניך זועפים היום?" אמר לה: "מפני פלוני שמצער אותי." אמרה לו: "אלהיהם של אלו שונא זימה; תן לי רשות ואכשיל אותו בדבר עבירה." והלכה וקישטה עצמה ובאת לפני רבי עקיבא. כשראה אותה, רקק ושחק ובכה. אמרה ליה: "פרש לי שלשה דברים הללו." אמר לה: "שתים אפרש, והשלישית לא אפרש: מה שרקקתי — שאת כותית ובאת מטיפה סרוחה ופסולה; מה שבכיתי — על האי שופרא דבלי בארעא." ומה ששחק לה — לא פירש לה; והוא שחק לפי שראה ברוח הקודש שעתידה להתגייר ולהנשא לו. אמרה לו: "יש לי תשובה?" אמר לה: "הן." הלכה ונתגיירה והכניס' לו ממון הרבה, ונשאה:
Tosafot on Nedarim 50b:1:1.english: The wife of Turnus Rufus - For Rabbi Akiva used to defeat Turnus Rufus before Caesar with [Scriptural] verses. One time, he [Turnus Rufus] went home sullen. His wife said to him: "Why is your face sullen today?" He said to her: "Because of So-and-so, who distresses me." She said to him: "The God of these [people] hates lewdness; give me permission, and I will cause him to stumble in a matter of sin." So she went and adorned herself, and came before Rabbi Akiva. When he saw her, he spat, laughed, and wept. She said to him: "Explain these three things to me." He said to her: "Two I will explain, and the third I will not explain: why I spat — because you are a Cuthean [gentile], and you come from a putrid and disqualified drop; why I wept — over this beauty that will decay in the earth." And why he laughed at her he did not explain to her; and he laughed because he saw through the Divine Spirit that she was destined to convert and marry him. She said to him: "Is there repentance for me?" He said to her: "Yes." She went and converted, and brought much wealth to him, and he married her.

Tosafot on Nedarim 50b:1:2.hebrew: קטיעא בר שלום - פ"ק דע"ז (דף י:) מפ':
Tosafot on Nedarim 50b:1:2.english: Ketia bar Shalom - [The Gemara] explains [this] in the first chapter of Avodah Zarah (10b):

Tosafot on Nedarim 50b:2:4.hebrew: אייתינהו נהליה - מדת חסידות עשו לו, ולא מן הדין; אלא אמרו: אחרי אשר על ידי גלגולו בא, נתנו לו:
Tosafot on Nedarim 50b:2:4.english: They brought them to him - They acted with a measure of piety toward him, and not [as required] by the law; rather, they said: since [this] came about through his agency, they gave [them] to him.

Tosafot on Nedarim 50b:4:1.english: If they were ugly - Meaning: ugly.

Tosafot on Nedarim 50b:6:2.english: That it is small - and he is able to swallow it:

Tosafot on Nedarim 50b:6:3.english: "It adheres to it" - That is to say, the pain adheres to it.

Tosafot on Nedarim 50b:7:1.hebrew: בקולחא - היינו ביצת טורמיטא, והיתה בודקת כל גופו, עד שהיה מפיג לבו:
Tosafot on Nedarim 50b:7:1.english: With a stalk - That is, a turmita egg, and it would examine his entire body, until it eased his heart.

Tosafot on Nedarim 50b:7:2.hebrew: עד דמסתרין אנשי ביתי' עליה - מסירין שערן מרוב צער:
Tosafot on Nedarim 50b:7:2.english: Until the members of his household would tear out [their hair] for him - They remove their hair out of great distress.

Tosafot on Nedarim 50b:8:1.hebrew: עשה בכלופסין לא יאכל בבנות שוח - פי': בפועל קאמר, שאמרה תורה שאוכל, ואמר התם שאינו אוכל אלא באותו המין. וכלופסין אינו ממין בנות שוח, ואע"ג ששניהם תאנים — שני מינים הם:
Tosafot on Nedarim 50b:8:1.english: [If he was] working with keloppasin, he may not partake of benot shuach - Explanation: [The Mishnah] is speaking of a worker, for the Torah said that he may eat [while working], and it states there [in the Mishnah] that he may only eat of that same species. And keloppasin is not of the species of benot shuach; even though both of them are figs, they are two [distinct] species.
